rationale: Added the missing rollback assertion to the existing PostgreSQL integration test: after the injected migration fails, qa_injected_failure must not exist. The retry assertion remains. The focused test command could not start because mvnw.cmd requires the unavailable powershell executable, so the corrected test has no fresh passing run evidence.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Initialize and validate the production Flyway migration chain before runtime work.
acceptance_checks.expected: An empty schema receives the full versioned chain; global catalog tables remain account-independent; account source state starts empty; baseline, clean and repair policies remain disabled.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Create the constrained global/account schema with GUID ownership and character-child ownership.
acceptance_checks.expected: Distinct accounts may use the same account-local key; duplicate keys within one account fail; a character child cannot reference another account's character; nullable inventory location components have explicit uniqueness behavior.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Reset unmanaged legacy or unrecognized schemas, then apply the full chain without fabricating synchronization history.
acceptance_checks.expected: Legacy rows are dropped; account_bank is recreated with account_id and the composite account_id/slot primary key; account_registry and account_source_state exist empty.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Failed managed migrations and checksum mismatches fail closed without resetting the managed schema.
acceptance_checks.expected: A failed version leaves no partial history or qa_injected_failure table; managed tables remain; retry succeeds using recorded history; checksum mismatch does not trigger reset.

invariants: Schema creation or reset does not fabricate an account or successful source completion.
Account-owned rows require a registry GUID, and character-owned rows reference a character under the same GUID.
Global catalog structure is shared and does not carry account_id.
Inventory bag/equipment null location components do not permit duplicate logical locations.
Only explicit unmanaged-schema reset drops legacy cache tables; ordinary managed migration failure and checksum mismatch never reset them.
Credentials, sessions, and API history are outside the schema contract.

interface_contract: infra.db.SchemaInitializer.initialize(javax.sql.DataSource, java.lang.String failureInjectionSql) — deterministic transactional migration failure injection used only by tests.

Production schema tables: account_registry(account_id UUID), account_source_state(account_id, source, generation, completed_at), account_bank(account_id, slot, item_id), characters(account_id, character_id, name), character_crafting(account_id, character_id, discipline, rating), character_items(account_id, character_id, location, bag_index, slot_index, equipment_slot, item_id, count), items.
test_specifications: Run SchemaInitializerPostgresTest against real PostgreSQL using a uniquely named disposable schema per test.
On an empty schema, assert the production chain creates account_registry, account_source_state, items and Flyway history, with no account/source rows and no legacy singleton account_sync_state.

Seed unscoped account_bank with a row and a conflicting items table; initialize through the production gate; assert account_bank is recreated with account_id and composite account_id/slot primary key, contains no seeded legacy rows, and account_registry/account_source_state remain empty.
Insert two GUIDs with the same bank slot and verify both persist; duplicate one GUID/slot and verify PostgreSQL rejects it.
Insert characters for two accounts; verify a character_crafting child with a mismatched account GUID is rejected.
Verify duplicate BAG location and duplicate EQUIPMENT slot are rejected even when other location columns are NULL.
Verify account_source_state starts empty and rejects a generation-zero completion marker.

Inject a deterministic failed migration after the managed schema exists; verify history is unchanged, qa_injected_failure does not exist after rollback, managed tables remain, and retry succeeds from recorded history.
Change a successful Flyway checksum and verify initialization fails without resetting account_registry.
Seed an unrecognized schema, verify explicit reset followed by full migration, and assert baseline, clean, and repair settings remain disabled.
